# Which builtin object types hit issue 4666, and what suppresses it.
# Written by probe-completion.py -- rerun it to re-derive.
# compiler: main-debug (the ground-truth build)
# exe: <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe
#
# Every case appends the same entry point:
#   float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   A-texture-array-param
# tests:  templated object type, array parameter
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x00000000
# result: ok
    void R(Texture2D<float4> T[4]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   B-sampler-array-param
# tests:  non-templated object type, array parameter -- the reported symptom
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x80004005
# result: DIAGNOSED
    void R(SamplerState S[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }
  -> error: variable has incomplete type 'SamplerState [2]'

==========================================================================
# case:   C-sampler-scalar-param
# tests:  same type, scalar parameter: isolates the array-ness
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x00000000
# result: ok
    void R(SamplerState S) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   D-global-sampler-before
# tests:  a prior global of that type, which forces completion first
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x00000000
# result: ok
    SamplerState g;
    void R(SamplerState S[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   E-global-sampler-after
# tests:  the same global moved AFTER: isolates declaration order
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x80004005
# result: DIAGNOSED
    void R(SamplerState S[2]) {}
    SamplerState g;
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }
  -> error: variable has incomplete type 'SamplerState [2]'

==========================================================================
# case:   F-struct-member-before
# tests:  the workaround named in the issue body
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x00000000
# result: ok
    struct X { SamplerState s[2]; };
    void R(SamplerState S[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   G-typedef-before
# tests:  naming the type without requiring it to be complete
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x80004005
# result: DIAGNOSED
    typedef SamplerState T2[2];
    void R(SamplerState S[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }
  -> error: variable has incomplete type 'SamplerState [2]'

==========================================================================
# case:   H-samplercomparisonstate-array
# tests:  a second non-templated sampler type
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x80004005
# result: DIAGNOSED
    void R(SamplerComparisonState S[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }
  -> error: variable has incomplete type 'SamplerComparisonState [2]'

==========================================================================
# case:   I-rwtexture-array-param
# tests:  a second templated object type
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x00000000
# result: ok
    void R(RWTexture2D<float4> T[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }

==========================================================================
# case:   J-byteaddressbuffer-array
# tests:  a non-templated buffer type: shows this is not sampler-specific
# cmd:    dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main scratch-completion-probe.hlsl
# exit:   0x80004005
# result: DIAGNOSED
    void R(ByteAddressBuffer B[2]) {}
    float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }
  -> error: variable has incomplete type 'ByteAddressBuffer [2]'

==========================================================================
# SUMMARY
#   diagnosed: B-sampler-array-param, E-global-sampler-after, G-typedef-before, H-samplercomparisonstate-array, J-byteaddressbuffer-array
#   accepted:  A-texture-array-param, C-sampler-scalar-param, D-global-sampler-before, F-struct-member-before, I-rwtexture-array-param
#
# Read against each other these say:
#   * array parameters of NON-templated builtin object types are diagnosed
#     (B, H, J) while templated ones are not (A, I) -- so this is not about
#     samplers as such, and Texture2D<float4> in the reported repro is a
#     red herring.
#   * the same type as a scalar parameter is accepted (C), so it is the
#     array form that is affected.
#   * anything earlier in the file that requires the type to be complete
#     suppresses it (D, F) and the same declaration placed later does not
#     (E), while merely naming the type does not (G). That is order-dependent
#     lazy completion, which is what makes the issue body's 'declaring an
#     unrelated struct makes it go away' true.
